- **M1** (`gaussian-differentiation.tex`, proof of `lem:gaussian-base-density`): new paragraph "The case j=0" right after L(y_0)=0. For j=0 the claim \(R\in\mathcal B_0(1,\cdot;y_0)\) (zero-order bound included, as defined in `packet-estimates`) only asks for \(|R(y_0)|\le1\), and \(R(y_0)=e^{L(y_0)}=1\); so \(K_0=1\) and no derivative of \(C\) or \(w\) enters. The rest of the proof is then for \(j\ge1\), so the maximum over \(1\le r\le j\) is non-empty. Statement unchanged.
- **N1** (`haar-chart.tex`): "with respect to \(h\)" and "preserve \(h\)" now say \(m_G\).
- **N2** (`compensated-variation.tex`): the inverse function theorem now gives a neighbourhood \(O\) of \((0,0)\) in \(\mathfrak g\times\mathfrak g^\perp\) mapped diffeomorphically onto an open neighbourhood \(V\) of \(1\), and \(\operatorname{Log}_*\colon V\to\mathfrak g\) is the colour component of the inverse. The later step reads "\((X,0)\in O\) is mapped to \(g\), so \(g\in V\) and, the map being injective on \(O\), \(\operatorname{Log}_*(g)=X\)".
